title: FrontmatterGeminiAgent
description: Frontmatter shape for nodes classified as `agent` by the Gemini Provider. Mirrors Google's documented Gemini CLI subagent frontmatter verbatim (https://geminicli.com/docs/core/subagents/): `name` and `description` come from the spec base; this schema adds the 7 vendor-specific fields. skill-map AGGREGATES the vendor spec, it does not curate it. `additionalProperties: true` so future Google additions flow through unchanged until this schema catches up. Note: Gemini's `kind` field (enum `local|remote`) lives at a different layer than the kernel's extension-kind discriminator and the node-kind discriminator — both use the word `kind` but in distinct namespaces (manifest vs frontmatter).

kind.description: Subagent execution mode. `local` runs in-process; `remote` is the documented value for the future remote-agent surface (https://geminicli.com/docs/core/remote-agents/).

tools.description: Tool names this subagent can invoke. Wildcards supported: `*` (all), `mcp_*` (all MCP), `mcp_<server>_*` (one MCP server). When omitted, the subagent inherits the parent session's full tool set.

mcpServers.description: Inline MCP server configuration isolated to this subagent. Shape is platform-defined; preserved as an opaque object.

model.description: Model id override (e.g. `gemini-3-flash-preview`). When omitted, inherits from the parent session.

temperature.description: Model sampling temperature. Range 0.0–2.0 per Google docs.

max_turns.description: Hard cap on conversation turns before the subagent must return.
